annotations.title: Post a video or photo post to TikTok

description: Use this when the user wants to post a video or photo post to TikTok now. Publishing costs no credits. Publish to the user’s connected TikTok account — a finished VIDEO, or a PHOTO POST (TikTok’s photo/slideshow format). A photo post carries 1 to 35 images and ONE image is simply a one-slide photo post, so there is nothing special to do for a single picture: pass imageUrls, in the order the slides should appear, and optionally coverIndex. Pass videoUrl for a video. Never pass both — TikTok has no mixed post. TWO destinations. destination:"post" (THE DEFAULT) publishes it LIVE on their profile: TikTok requires the user to CHOOSE the privacy themselves (no default is allowed), so call tiktok_creator_info, show them their real privacy options, and get their choice and an explicit yes before calling. destination:"draft" is ONLY for when the user asks for a draft, or wants to add a TikTok sound or trending audio (TikTok’s API takes no sound for a VIDEO): BEFORE sending, tell them plainly it lands in their TikTok inbox as a DRAFT, that they add the sound in TikTok’s editor, and that THEY must publish it from the TikTok app — nothing goes live until they do. Never pick draft on your own. A photo post published with destination:"post" gets a TikTok-recommended track automatically (autoAddMusic, default on) that they can change in the app. Pass Hermoso render URLs (or upload_file urls for local/external files). Needs TikTok connected (Connectors > TikTok).

account.description: WHICH connected account of this channel to post as — its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts. Needed only when the profile has more than one tiktok account connected (several and none named is refused by name, never guessed); omit when there is one.

adsOnly.description: VIDEO: publish as an "Only show in ads" post. It stays off the profile and exists to be run as a Spark Ad (authorize it with the TikTok Ads tools). Anyone with the link can still open it.

aiGenerated.description: TikTok’s is_aigc AI-generated-content label (video posts). OMIT IT and Hermoso decides from provenance: a Hermoso render is declared, a video that came through upload_file or an external URL (the user’s own footage) is NOT. true/false overrides.

autoAddMusic.description: photo posts only: let TikTok add a recommended track (default true — a silent slideshow reads as broken)

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to, for THIS CALL ONLY (beats the connection’s pin): an id or exact name from list_brands. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

brandedContent.description: discloses a paid partnership — cannot be combined with SELF_ONLY privacy

coverIndex.description: photo posts: which slide is the cover, 0-based. Default 0 (the first slide).

coverTimestampMs.description: video only: which frame to use as the cover, in ms

destination.description: "post" (default) = live on the profile now (needs the privacy the user chose + their explicit yes); "draft" = to their TikTok inbox for them to finish and publish in the app — only when they ask for a draft or want to add a TikTok sound, and only after telling them so.

disableComment.description: true = turn comments off on this post

disableDuet.description: video only — TikTok has no duet on a photo post

disableStitch.description: video only — TikTok has no stitch on a photo post

hook.description: Post_performance ranks hooks on it (a winner needs 5 posts sharing one); omitted, this post never votes.

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

imageUrls.description: a PHOTO POST: 1–35 image URLs in slide order. One url = a single-image photo post. Do not combine with videoUrl.

locationId.description: TAG A PLACE on the post: the locationId search_tiktok_locations returns. Needs locationName too. Setting this, musicSoundId or adsOnly publishes through TikTok’s Business endpoint (the TikTok account authorized under Connectors ▸ TikTok Ads, which must be the account this brand posts as): public only for a video, at most 15 such posts a day per account, direct posts only (not drafts).

locationName.description: the place name exactly as search_tiktok_locations listed it; TikTok requires it with locationId

musicEndMs.description: VIDEO: where in the track to stop, in milliseconds (default: the video’s length)

musicSoundId.description: a COMMERCIAL MUSIC LIBRARY track under the post (pre-cleared for brand and ad use): a songClipId from tiktok_ads_trending kind "sounds". Video or photo post.

musicStartMs.description: VIDEO: where in the track to start, in milliseconds (default 0)

musicVolume.description: VIDEO: how loud that track plays, 0-100. Default 50, as in the TikTok app (TikTok’s API default is 0, which attaches a track nobody hears).

originalSoundVolume.description: VIDEO with musicSoundId: how loud the video’s OWN sound (voiceover, dialogue) plays under the track, 0-100. Default 50, as in the TikTok app; 0 mutes it. TikTok has this only together with a Commercial Music Library track.

photoTitle.description: photo posts only: a short title above the caption (≤90 chars). Defaults to the caption’s first line.

platformCover.description: VIDEO COVER. Omit it (the default) and Hermoso sets the video’s best frame — the same frame as its Library thumbnail — as the cover (TikTok video_cover_timestamp_ms, on a direct post — a draft takes no cover, you pick it in the TikTok app). true = send no cover and let the platform pick (usually the first frame). A cover you pass yourself always wins.

privacy.description: REQUIRED for destination:"post", for photos and video alike. Must be one the creator actually allows — read them from tiktok_creator_info, never guess.

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

subject.description: what the post is about (product, feature, offer or theme): post_performance’s second axis, so reuse the exact wording.

title.description: the caption — hashtags go here (video ≤2200 chars, photo post ≤4000)

videoUrl.description: the video to post — a Hermoso render URL or an upload_file url. Omit for a photo post; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

yourBrand.description: discloses that this promotes the creator’s own brand
